verdict.rationale:
Semgrep exposes a documented `--metrics=off` flag that disables usage/telemetry reporting, confirmed working in a hands-on CLI probe run without requiring an account, and the CLI is documented to run entirely locally/offline by default. This gives AI-native users a concrete, verifiable way to opt out of telemetry.

missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs page explaining exactly what telemetry/metrics data is collected by default and why, an environment-variable equivalent for CI pipelines, and independent community confirmation that the opt-out fully works as claimed.
